verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Linux GPU machines can be created from the console, the REST API or the CLI, with a choice of machine type, template, region and starting state. SSH with root access and the 'ML in a Box' template (preinstalled frameworks and CUDA) let you start running code quickly. The vendor claims you can go from signup to training in seconds, but a hands-on community report calls getting SSH access an 'uphill battle' with a confusing GUI, and high-end GPUs such as the H100 need approval, so they are not instantly on-demand. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of minutes-to-running-code, ungated on-demand access to top-tier GPUs, a smooth hands-on SSH onboarding experience.
